description: Frequency-of-frequencies (k-mer spectrum): for each occurrence count c, how many distinct k-mers occur exactly c times. Optional Jellyfish counting modes (canonical = count -C, acgtOnly) and jellyfish histo options (low, high, increment, full) that add a binned histogram (counts above high pooled in the last bin).

acgtOnly.description: Skip windows containing a symbol other than A/C/G/T (case-insensitive)

low.description: jellyfish histo -l/--low (default 1); giving any histo option fills histogram

high.description: jellyfish histo -h/--high (default 10000, >= low); counts above it go to the last (cap) bin

full.description: jellyfish histo -f/--full: also list empty bins

spectrum.description: Map from occurrence count to number of distinct k-mers reaching that count

histogram.description: jellyfish histo rows (bin = bucket low end point, frequency = distinct k-mers in it), ascending; null unless a histo option is given

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
High count value must be >= low count value
increment must be >= 1; low must be >= 0

examples.name: Canonical histo with cap bin (BA1B sample, k=4, -C, histo -f -l 2 -h 6; Jellyfish 2.3.1)
